تعترضين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِضِينَ (taʕtariḍīna) /taʕ.ta.ri.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# تُعْتَرَضِينَ (tuʕtaraḍīna) /tuʕ.ta.ra.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
